comment: Hand-drawn schematic by Clay Jones (1/20/04), titled 'Grand Laff Dynamic Overhype', with build notes (Blue Xicon filter caps, Sprague buffer cap, AVX polyester box NP caps, carbon comp resistors, '2% silver solder, the secret'). The drawing has no designators, so the parts are numbered here in signal order. Image 2 combines the same schematic with Andy Harrison's 'Dynamic Overhype' vero layout (adapted from Torchy's Tube Screamer layout) and a PCB layout.
uncertain: Which clipping network each switch position selects is not fully clear on the drawing: the notes give up = TS808, center = diode lift, down = 'Marshall' (the LEDs).
The clipping diode network is drawn as one 1N914 one way and two 1N914 in series the other way; the vero layout's parts list has three 1N914s and two red LEDs, consistent with this.
The layouts in image 2 use different pot values and tapers (vero: Drive B1M, Tone B20K, Level A100K; PCB: A500K, B20K, B100K) and a 200p feedback capacitor where the schematic has 51p.
